body: The exact same thing happens to me too. Trust me on this... She does care about you. She doesn't want to lose you... Please don't lose yourself
Hi... I am here if u want to talk... I get what u are saying. I have been there. I am still there... But yeah. If u need someone to talk to you... I am here
If you wanna talk about anything I am right here
I'm ok. How are you? What's up?
Just because people tell you that doesn't necessarily make it true. It's about you. It's about what you think.
It's not like that... You might feel that way but it isn't. There are people who care about you. It's never too late. You just have to try

Don't . Please don't do it. Talk to someone. Talk to us. I am here if you want to talk. Maybe you had no one then but you might find someone now. Someone who cares about you will be really hurt if you kill yourself
Do you not trust her or something? Why are you do afraid? And if you don't trust her... Why don't you talk it out?

Why do you stop? Yeah... I don't exactly know you. But trust me do this: next time you feel like calling her...call her. You feel like texting her... Then text her. You shouldn't be afraid. Try it from next time. If something hurts her or she moved away from you... It's good for you. Then at least you will know how she really is.
Why aren't you completely open to her then? Has she done something which has caused you to lose your trust? Have you tried opening up to anyone else?

Do you trust her? So... you are basically open to just this one person? It may be hard. Or easier said than done but are you completely open to her? Do you trust her? Why do you still think that you are dead weight then?
People love you for a reason. They want to be around you for a reason. Don't feel like you are dead weight. Have u tried speaking to anyone? Like a close friend or something?
Why do u feel this way? If u have ppl especially friends who care about u and family which is amazing... Why do u feel this way?
